description: Covered negative target sets prune impossible assignments before the variant cap.
grammar:
%rule text x (r0 | r1 | r2 | r3 | r4)
%rule x A :: ($.followed-by(r0) ⟹ Tag-0) ∪ ($.followed-by(r0 | r1) ⟹ Tag-1) ∪ ($.followed-by(r0 | r1 | r2) ⟹ Tag-2) ∪ ($.followed-by(r0 | r1 | r2 | r3) ⟹ Tag-3) ∪ ($.followed-by(r0 | r1 | r2 | r3 | r4) ⟹ Tag-4)
%rule r0 B
%rule r1 C
%rule r2 D
%rule r3 E
%rule r4 F
